name: Economy log: Vanity Store, vanity collection, Heirloom Weapon store and Call Board token spending are logged
contract: With the economy log on, a Vanity Store purchase writes one vanity_store_buy row with the item and the Bazaar Tokens it cost, for a collection item and for a consumable alike; buying into the collection is not also a vanity_collect.
An item that enters the vanity collection any other way writes one vanity_collect row with the item.

A purchase from the Heirloom Weapon store writes one heirloom_token_buy row with the weapon and the Heirloom Weapon Token (414010) it cost; a Call Board contract completed with Bazaar Tokens writes one tokens_spent row with the tokens taken.

This server's VanityCollection.dbc sells the Dealer's Draft Deck (777910) for 500 tokens and Keeper's Scroll: Golganneth (696661, consumable) for 60; Feather of Ancients: Azeroth (134989) joins the collection when it is obtained; the Heirloom Weapon store (custom store 7) sells the Bloodied Arcanite Reaper (1642943) for one token.

Duel! (quest 80651) rewards 40 Bazaar Tokens, so its first Complete Now costs 40 x 2.0 = 80 tokens (CoA.CallboardContracts.TokenCostMultiplier 2.0, MinTokenCost 50); the completion then grants the quest's 40 tokens and the Ethereal Bazaar's random quest bonus, so the bag count alone does not show the price.
